records.text: Paper card. Question: Can a data-driven discovery cycle be used to identify optimal complex-solid-solution materials for electrocatalytic reactions?. System: Ag-Ir-Pd-Pt-Ru. Processing: Combinatorial co-sputtering from five elemental targets. Test conditions: Scanning droplet cell (SDC) measurements in 0.1 M HClO4. Findings: 1.01; 0.1; 0.2; 820; 1000. Mechanism: The interaction between adsorbates and resultant blocking creates the active surface. Quote: "millions of different active sites"
